input: intervals is a plain list of plain two-element lists [start, end]; each endpoint is an integer, excluding bool. Every interval represents a half-open meeting [start, end) with start < end. The calendar may be empty, unsorted, contain duplicate meetings or share row objects. Zero-length and reversed meetings are outside the domain. Preconditions are not checked at runtime.
return: A bool: True exactly when no two half-open meetings overlap; an empty calendar returns True. A meeting ending at time t does not overlap one starting at t. After independent endpoint sorting, no overlap is equivalent to starts[i] >= ends[i - 1] for every i from 1 through n - 1.
mutation_aliasing: No writes to the supplied outer list/array or any interval row. Only new endpoint arrays are sorted. Shared input rows remain shared and unchanged. The result is a scalar; no retained references or persistent Solution instance state.
numeric: The paired contract restricts endpoints to integers in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991] and n <= 4294967295. Python integer comparisons, counters and indices are exact. Bool is excluded. No arithmetic is performed on endpoint values, and signed-zero identity is not distinguished.
complexity: n is the number of meetings. O(n log(n + 1)) time for two endpoint sorts plus O(n) scanning; O(n) auxiliary space for both endpoint copies and sorting workspace. Python built-in comparison sorting is charged. Each sorted start is examined at most once.

helpers.name: sorted_endpoints
helpers.contract: Returns two fresh lists of numeric endpoint values: starts sorted ascending and ends independently sorted ascending. Original interval order and rows are unchanged; sorting does not retain meeting pair correspondence.
helpers.cost: One call per candidate. Two O(n) endpoint copies and two comparison sorts, O(n log(n + 1)) time and O(n) auxiliary space including sort workspace under the declared runtime assumptions. Its complete identical definition is included in both meeting candidates. The helper definition is 221 UTF-8 bytes including its terminal newline.

source_accounting: Standalone UTF-8 source is 558 bytes. All endpoint-copy construction, comparator source where present, sort invocations, helper definitions, Solution class, method, loops and result logic are charged as standalone source. The shared helper is fully included in each file, not imported. Any eventual judge adapter must also be charged.
